diagnostics.message: aws_lambda_function.syncer must wait for aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.syncer_vpc_execution_role when VPC subnets are configured. Referencing the role alone does not ensure its ENI-management permissions are attached before Lambda creates its VPC networking, and removal must occur after function deletion.

aws_s3_object.trigger immediately invokes the syncer through S3, but does not wait for aws_iam_role_policy.syncer. The initial synchronization can run before its S3 access policy exists; make the trigger wait for this policy.

aws_s3_object.trigger can invoke the function before aws_iam_role_policy.lambda_logging is installed (and before its dependent log group is ready). Wait for the logging policy before uploading the deployment trigger to avoid losing initial invocation logs.

When a customer KMS key is configured, aws_s3_object.trigger can invoke the syncer before aws_iam_role_policy.lambda_kms grants access to that key, causing the initial encrypted distribution upload to fail. Order the trigger after this conditional policy.

When tracing is enabled, aws_s3_object.trigger can invoke the function before aws_iam_role_policy.syncer_lambda_xray grants tracing permissions. Wait for this conditional policy before emitting the initial invocation event.

aws_cloudwatch_event_target.syncer can activate scheduled invocations before aws_lambda_permission.syncer permits EventBridge to invoke the function. Order target creation after the permission to avoid a window of denied scheduled invocations.
